subject: Scale on scantwo plot not visible

messages.author: a236f0620b7b691f
messages.subject: Scale on scantwo plot not visible
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to plot the output of my scantwo analysis (Two QTL scan), but somehow the scale that usually displays the LOD score (i and f) range does not show up on the right. Do I need to add anything else in the plot command line to make it appear?

Thanks!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Scale on scantwo plot not visible
parts:
I've not noticed any problems; I can't tell what's going wrong for you. Can you give further details?
It should be that the color scale is automatic; it's controlled by the argument zscale with default zscale=TRUE.

If you do the following, do you get the plot with the color scale?

library(qtl)
data(hyper)
hyper <- subset(hyper, chr=c(1,19))
hyper <- calc.genoprob(hyper)
out <- scantwo(hyper, method="hk")
plot(out)

What versions of R and R/qtl are you using?

R.version
qtlversion()

karl
